set.body:
Scheduling lane: research. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Research comparison retained; frozen exposure/eligibility rules apply. Not an engineering prerequisite or proof of behavioral recovery.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1a Step 1b.

Friends alone leaves the single final test with perhaps ten participants. Memento has 133 participants across four conditions (docs/data/memento/README.md). Owner decision 2026-09-18: admit and seal. Blocker 2 of the Memento record (an ethics basis for committing recall prose) bars only committing text; analysis reads the staged bytes from the ignored data root.

Scope:
Record admission, fix the task definition, draw and guard a stratified split before any model or tuning inspection.

Acceptance criteria:
1. docs/data/memento records the owner's admission decision (2026-09-18) and its scope; nothing text-bearing is committed.
2. A versioned task descriptor fixes: scene gold on the five-second grid; accuracy counts only codes 1-2, codes 3-5 never; the seven non-integer rows are excluded explicitly by id; the population comes from recall-population.json, with the three missing sheets and four sheetless rows each handled by an explicit rule.
3. The descriptor names condition 1 (nonlinear cut) as the transfer test and condition 4 (linear re-cut) as its control.
4. A participant-level test split stratified by the four conditions is drawn with a committed seed; membership, per-condition counts, power assumptions and minimum detectable effect are committed before any model or tuning inspection of Memento.
5. The same guard as the Friends split (listed readers, grep test, mutation witness) and a committed zero-read ledger.

Gate: every script in tools/recall-study/tests exits 0 (`for t in tools/recall-study/tests/test_*.py;
do python3 "$t" || exit 1; done`), new tests included; a named mutation witness per new guard; no
recall prose or participant text committed (hashes and aggregates only); fresh-context cold review;
the commit body states the evidence and what it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: [research] Phase 1a: admit Memento, fix its task, and seal a condition-stratified test split
